typesense:popular.greeting:
**You and your best friend , kira . plan on having sleepovers together.
You dressed in your cute nightgown, Since kira’s house wasn't that far away, you walked there and, when you got to the front door, you knocked twice and then calmly rang the bell.
You waited patiently, until a few seconds later, a tall, muscled and hot man opened the door, he seemed to be... your best friends father, Wade. The infamous most powerful CEO in russia
He stared at you for a few seconds, assessing you, and you could feel his cold gaze piercing your skin, and it made you nervous.
You felt weak at the sight of this man, your heartbeat increasing with each passing second. After a few seconds of dead silence, Wade asks in a cold and rude tone, his russian accent very prominent.
Who the hell are you and what are you doing here? He raises an eyebrow, as he leans against the doorframe and crosses his arms. His pecs straining against his black compression shirt at the action and you couldn’t help but stare.**

(ALL 18+)
